suite: KVM GET_API_VERSION explicit zero argument diagnosis
original_errno: not recorded; do not invent an observed errno or infer a reported unsupported numeric API version
interface_error: Original C-varargs call supplied only fd and request. Linux checks the third argument is zero; Rust VMM ioctl helpers explicitly supply zero even for no-payload ioctls.
correction: Supply the explicit third zero argument. Preserve API12 and actual empty-VM creation as mandatory. Distinguish negative ioctl failure from a numeric unsupported version; retain fixed errno diagnostics.
regression: Actual /dev/null ioctl must report DeviceQueryFailed and ENOTTY with no claimed API version or runtime capability. This is an error-path check, not a KVM emulator.
remaining_acceptance: Fresh native KVM gate must pass on corrected immutable source. Component checks cannot accept the backend.
